text:
yvonne (People Ops): Quick thread 10s: hiring requests a comp-band exception + frontloaded equity for a cross-border hire relocating to US payroll. Need routing and suggested SLA.

leo (Recruiter): Candidate: Hana Ito. Current offer in JPY -> base ~ $128k USD post-conversion. L5 cap is $120k. Hiring asks for $12k sign-on + 0.08% equity with 3-mo first tranche (then regular cadence). Candidate is open but prefers May 10 start.

sam (Hiring Manager): Hana is leading the infra model rollout; losing her delays critical Q3 work. Recommend approve base exception + sign-on and the accelerated equity tranche. Can we mark urgent? :pray:

maria (Finance): Need run-rate vs one-time breakdown + cost-center. Quick calc snippet:
```base_usd = 128000
benefits = base_usd * 0.22 (~28160)
one_time = 12000 (sign-on) + 10000 (relocation top-up)
est_1yr_cost = base_usd + benefits + 22000 ~ 178,160
```
We need GL mapping for sign-on and relocation and headcount confirmation. If recruiting shifts some budget from global hiring pool, easier.

kevin (Legal): A couple notes: 1) payroll conversion requires tax/immigration check; start date should be "pending payroll & work auth" 2) accelerated equity needs exec-comp + equity team sign-off and updated grant paperwork.

yvonne (People Ops): Routing plan: open approval APPR-5333 to exec-comp, finance, legal, and equity. Attach offer, finance calc, and headcount memo. Request 48hr review (expedited). I can draft the memo if Leo drops the offer link.

leo (Recruiter): Offer uploaded: /files/HanaI-offer.pdf and headcount memo: https://docs.internal/hana-headcount. Candidate OK with conditional start pending approvals.

approvals-bot: Approval request created: APPR-5333. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, legal, equity. SLA: 48 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-5333

maria (Finance): I'll provisionally approve the one-time items if recruiting confirms GLs: SIG-ONE-54 and RELOC-INT-09. Will post final within 24h once GLs attached.

sam (Hiring Manager): Happy to add business-impact note and join a 10-min sync if needed.

yvonne (People Ops): If exec-comp approves, next steps: 1) set start date "pending payroll/immigration" 2) include conditional accelerated-equity language 3) confirm tax treatment of relocation in offer. Please react with :thumbsup: once you've left your approval note on APPR-5333 so I can close this thread.

(sam) :thumbsup:
(maria) :thumbsup:
(kevin) :eyes:
